This Hazardous Weather Outlook is for north and central Georgia.

.DAY ONE...This Afternoon and Tonight...

Gusty winds this afternoon may cause additional tree damage in
areas that received heavy rain from Isaias. Additional hazards 
are not expected. 

.DAYS TWO THROUGH SEVEN...Monday through Saturday...

No hazardous weather conditions expected.

.SPOTTER INFORMATION STATEMENT...

Spotter activation will not be needed through tonight.

Spotter activation is not requested but spotters are encouraged 
to submit reports of severe weather through the web by going to 
weather.gov/atlanta. Please relay any information about observed 
severe weather to the NWS while following all local and state 
guidelines.
